findings.note: Filed HB 304 (89th session). As filed, a voter showing a driver's license or ID card marked 'VALID FOR VOTING ONLY WITH VERIFICATION OF ELIGIBILITY' (issued without proof of citizenship) could be accepted only if also showing proof of U.S. citizenship; otherwise a provisional ballot. House Elections Committee reported a substitute version 2025-04-14 (5 ayes, 3 nays); last action 2025-04-23 sent to Calendars.
subjects: photo ID type accepted at the polls

findings.motion: HB 304 committee bill analysis, background and purpose
findings.note: The committee analysis records the author's stated reason: the author told the committee that under current state law people can get a driver's license, commercial license or ID certificate without proving U.S. citizenship. Passage by the full House or Senate was not confirmed.

Filed HB 521 on accommodating voters with a disability, amending the Election Code section on a voter unable to enter the polling place (curbside voting) and creating criminal offenses. History page shows it effective 2025-09-01. A June 2025 news report says he told the House Elections Committee he was concerned about possible misuse of curbside voting (reporter's paraphrase, not saved as his words).
